breakdown.description: Boundary section contains incompatible boundary condition types (e.g., periodic vs Dirichlet/Neumann).
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified the conflict between the specified Dirichlet boundary conditions and the request for periodic boundaries. It resolved this by omitting the contradictory periodic condition and only including the Dirichlet conditions `u(0,t)=1` and `u(1,t)=-1`, which matches the correction made in the ground truth.
